title: 364th Basic Training Class graduates from Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center
summary_en: Community members and law enforcement personnel filled Integrity Hall at the Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center on Oct. 23 to watch 21 students graduate and become the newest members of the law enforcement community.
title_cn: 364th Basic Training Class graduates from Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center

title: Kansas Fire & Rescue Training Institute hosts first international class since 2015
summary_en: Earlier this month, Kansas Fire & Rescue Training Institute hosted its first international class in a decade as four Taiwanese firefighters came to Lawrence and Salina for the 80-hour Structural Collapse Awareness Operations Technician Certification, training alongside Kansas firefighters and task force members to gain accreditation for Taiwan’s USAR program.
title_cn: Kansas Fire & Rescue Training Institute hosts first international class since 2015

title: KU expert available to discuss decisive factors in Israel’s Oct. 27 election
summary_en: Rami Zeedan, associate professor of Israel studies, is available to speak with journalists before and after the election about these factors and their implications for the next government. Zeedan is available for interviews in English, Arabic or Hebrew.
title_cn: KU expert available to discuss decisive factors in Israel’s Oct. 27 election
